title: Merry Morning Breakfast with Santa
seo_title: Breakfast with Santa at Bass Pro Shops, Springfield MO
description: This is a holiday breakfast with Santa where guests get a complimentary breakfast, a Santa hat cup giveaway, candy canes, and a free photo with Santa. It is a family-oriented morning, and admission is free, but reservations are required and open November 28. It takes place Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM at Bass Pro Shops, 1 Bass Pro Dr, Springfield, MO.
